children: Arabian Centres Company (Cenomi Centers) signed a design-and-build contract for the mall and office components of Saudi Downtown Company’s Madinah project.

The contract for the Madinah Downtown project was signed with Lynx Contracting Company and is valued at 825 million Saudi riyals ($219.74 million), the comapny said in a statement to the Saudi stock exchange.

The 30-month contract covers the design and construction of the mall and office components, including related engineering, construction, supply, installation, testing, commissioning and handover works, in accordance with the agreed contractual terms.
Saudi Downtown is a subsidiary of Saudi sovereign fund the Public Investment Fund (PIF).
